blocks.text: Scottsdale homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Scottsdale, October 2026. Detached houses: 41 listed at month end and 8 sold in October, a sales ratio of 20% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 25 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 38 sold over 5 months against an average of 49.8 listed, about 6.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 10 sold. Condos and townhomes: 11 sold over 5 months against an average of 25.2 listed, about 11.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 6 sold.

faq.a: It is a TransLink bus exchange at the Scott Road / 72 Avenue node and the anchor of the OCP's Scottsdale Exchange TOD Area; the City states the exchange itself sits on the Surrey side of Scott Road, at the Delta border.
faq.q: What is Scottsdale Exchange, and is it in Delta?

faq.a: The R6 Scott Road RapidBus connects Scott Road Station with Newton Exchange, with a boarding area at Scott Road and 72nd Avenue.

The City states Bill 47 requires minimum densities within a Transit Oriented Development Area extending 400 metres from Scottsdale Exchange, and Delta adopted SSMUH zoning allowing combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites.
faq.q: What does Bill 47 change near the exchange?

faq.a: No — the Province lists duplexes as a form strata housing can take, which means a duplex may be strata-titled or not; check the title and strata plan for a specific property.
faq.q: Is a duplex in Scottsdale always a strata?
